Messages.Author: Dave Andrews
Messages.Body:
I want to make sure this works. I have Anson, equipped with an Ivory Bow and
dragging along the Ghoul Retainer. If he gets into combat, and he uses his
hands while the Ghoul Retainer uses the Ivory Bow, Rotschreck can't be played
because it says "...when a minion attempts to use aggravated damage..." and
the Ghoul Retainer is a retainer, not a minion. Is this right?

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dave Andrews
S2...@nmu.edu

Actually, card text has Rotschrek only effecting Vampires, who were
about to recieve agg damage. The erata to cause it to work the other way (and
no longer have anything to do with Rotschrek, from V:tM) has left us with some
very weird rules questions. (Hey, if it effects the minion, why CAN'T you send
the Flame Thrower equipped Street Gang into Torpor?)
